noPermission.title: Final inspection is not for your role
noPermission.body: Your role does not open final inspections at this bench. Ask your team leader.

role.record: Your role views inspections but does not record them.

offline.held: Inspections and releases take their number from the office at once: they wait for the network.

pick.hint: Or pick one of the work orders with finished garments below.

camera.error: The camera does not open. Use the scanner or type the number.

pick.notFound: No work order {code} at this site.
pick.notReady: Work order {code} is {status}: its garments are inspected while it is released, in progress or completed.

empty.title: Nothing waits for final inspection
empty.body: No work order of this site has finished garments to inspect or release.

pick.title: Finished, to inspect or release

maker.made: You worked on this order. Another inspector must inspect and release it.
maker.ok: You made none of these garments.

rule.WHEN_REQUIRED: An inspector who made none of the garments releases alone; a second person only for overrides and listed customers.
rule.ALWAYS: This company asks a second person for every final release, after the inspector's signature.
rule.customer: This customer's garments always need a second person: another inspector releases them.

held.othersOpen: Another inspector has an inspection open on this order.
held.nothing: Nothing to inspect or release on this order now.

cell.counts: {pieces} pieces · {released} released · {releasable} can be released now

held.noRight: Your role does not release garments.
held.maker: You worked on this order: another inspector releases it.
held.checks: A check is open: see what to do above.
held.nothing: Nothing of this size can be released now.

fix.WORK_ORDER: Ask the office: the work order must be released, in progress or completed.
fix.INSPECTION: Inspect the garments and sign the result first.
fix.QUANTITY: Release fewer garments, or inspect the rest in a new inspection.
fix.SERIALS: Scan or pick the serials of these garments again.
fix.LABELS: Print the garment labels at the final operation first (Garment labels).
fix.CERTIFICATE: Ask the compliance lead: a valid certificate must cover this colour and size today.
fix.DOCUMENTS: Ask the office to file the signed declaration of conformity and the user information.
fix.LOTS: Ask quality to decide the material lot first.
fix.MAKER: Another inspector, who made none of these garments, releases them.
fix.SECOND_PERSON: Another inspector, not the one who signed the result, releases them.

secondPerson.OVERRIDE: the inspection overrode its computed result
secondPerson.CUSTOMER: this customer's garments always need a second person
secondPerson.ALWAYS: the company asks a second person for every release

plan.title: The inspection plan
plan.lead: Every garment of the lot is checked, no defect accepted. If the customer's plan accepts defects, change the numbers before you open (sampling with AQL tables comes later).

checklist.groupAnswered: Every check of this group is answered: pick the next group.
checklist.resultPass: Result now: PASS — no failed check, defects within the plan.
checklist.resultFail: Result now: FAIL — {failed} failed check(s), {defects} defect(s) recorded.

item.EN17092_CLASS_LABEL: EN 17092 class label matches the certificate
item.ARMOUR_FITTED: Armour fitted, right size, EN 1621 marked
item.USER_INFORMATION: User information in the market's languages

hold.title: Hold this lot?
hold.body: Packing is blocked until quality decides.
hold.ncr_one: {count} garment goes on quality hold, and a nonconformance opens for quality to decide.
hold.ncr_other: {count} garments go on quality hold, and a nonconformance opens for quality to decide.
hold.done: On hold: {reason} · {ncr}. Packing is blocked until quality decides.
hold.line: On hold since {since}: {reason} · {ncr}. Releasing and packing wait for quality.
hold.lineNoNcr: On hold since {since}: {reason}. Releasing and packing wait for quality.
hold.releaseWaits: On hold: releasing waits for quality

held.offline: Holding needs the network: it waits until it is back.
held.noRight: Your role does not inspect: ask the inspector or quality.

sign.meaningPass: With your PIN you confirm you inspected these garments and the result is PASS.
sign.meaningFail: With your PIN you confirm you inspected these garments and the result is FAIL: they are not released.
sign.statement: I did not make these goods
sign.tickFirst: This site records stations, not people: tick "I did not make these goods" before you sign.

release.signTitle_one: Sign the release of {count} garment of {cell}
release.signTitle_other: Sign the release of {count} garments of {cell}
release.meaning: With your PIN you confirm you inspected these goods and release them for shipping.

labels.lead_other: At least {count} more labels are needed before the next release. They print on the site's label printer that holds this label.

done.title_other: Released · batch {batch} · {count} garments · packing can start.

done.secondPerson: Released by you as the second person.
